title: US Open 2026: Osaka, Swiatek, Keys and Auger-Aliassime in action on day five – live
text:
Auger-Aliassime starts as he means to go on, with an opening hold to love. The Canadian is in a slightly strange position at this tournament: he’s at a career-high grand slam seeding of No 3 and world ranking of No 4, but he’s not really being loudly talked about in the title conversation. Twice a grand slam semi-finalist, both times at the US Open, including last year, he still needs to prove he’s got a final gear – especially after he failed to make the most of the wide-open draws at the French Open and Wimbledon this summer. He’s happier on a hard court, though, and this is by far his most successful slam.
And if you need to play catch-up with any of yesterday’s action, you can do so here:
The players are warming up on all the courts except Arthur Ashe, and even the sun has decided to make an appearance after a couple of days in hiding. There are some big names among the early runners and riders: Felix Auger-Aliassime (3) v Karen Khachanov, Iga Swiatek (8) v Nadia Podoroska and Madison Keys (22) v Anna Bondar.

Hello, hello! And welcome to our day five coverage of the US Open, where the first round has finally concluded after this week’s rain interruptions and we’ll get the chance to have a second look at the title credentials of Taylor Fritz, Iga Swiatek, Mirra Andreeva, Amanda Anisimova and Felix Auger-Aliassime – along with Naomi Osaka’s latest fashion statement and the mania surrounding the Filipino phenom that is Alexandra Eala.
Britain’s Fran Jones and Harriet Dart are also in second-round action - Jones has a tough assignment against the home star in the making Iva Jovic and Dart plays the Czech 25th seed Marie Bouzkova - while Alex de Minaur, Flavio Cobolli, Lorenzo Musetti, Madison Keys and Michael Zheng, another rising American, play in the day session too (Coco Gauff, Alexander Zverev, Elena Rybakina and Gael Monfils are all in the night session).
The action begins at 11am New York time/4pm BST - which gives you just enough time to get in the mood with a Honey Deuce. Cheers!
